item.title: Lindsey Vonn crashes in Olympic downhill, taken away by helicopter as US teammate Johnson wins gold

item.title: Seahawks ride their 'Dark Side' defense to a Super Bowl title, pounding the Patriots 29-13
item.description: Tom Brady once led Bill Belichick’s Patriots to the greatest comeback in Super Bowl history, when New England rallied from a 28-3 deficit against Atlanta for a 34-28 overtime victory.
